prompt: Through a passenger's side window at night, long lens: the next three lanes of a jammed British motorway stacked tight, families in their cars lit by dashboard glow, a man standing on the hard shoulder staring back the way they came, a far-off orange glow under the clouds behind him. Rain beads on the glass in the foreground. Night in a near-future Britain, photographed like a feature film on 35mm stock: fine grain, inky blacks that stay black, no lens flare, no bloom. 16:9. No writing anywhere in the frame: no number plates, signs, logos or screen text.
